name: hit_source_update_timed_status
description: HitSource::UpdateTimedStatus applies timed-hit status flags and target-level changes, allocates a status light when needed, and returns the current-level band.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a zWeapon timed-hit/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2210 validates setting hitSource and the low two status flags, using OptCatalogEntryDef flags bit 0x200 to subtract rather than add the amount, clamping targetLevel to [-1, 1], allocating/attaching a light only when lightNode is null, and returning band 2 below -0.5, 1 through 0.0, or 0 above 0.0.
The native timed-hit smoke verifies add and subtract/clamp paths, light allocation and parent/world attachment, existing-light no-allocation behavior, and all three return bands.
